notes.title: Update 20.06.2024
notes.content:
[b]Welcome![/b]

Today's update doesn't revolve around the list of changes, but around the gamepad knob! From today Clash II receives full support for this type of controller. This is not the only change - players waiting for new maps for Skirmish mode can try their hand at three new maps:
[list]
[*] King of the Golems (1 vs 1)
[*] With Fire and Wood (3 players)
[*] The Great Hunt (4 players)
[/list]
Another change is related to graphics - the backgrounds in the city screens have been changed to be more vivid and detailed, while optimization has been improved. This is one of several factors that should positively affect the loading time of the castle scene.
In addition, the update includes a solid pack of patches and bugfixes.

[b]For Karkhan![/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39937002/0bad466e8ecc9151e0f135322fad82dd2da52265.gif[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.0 - release
notes.content:
[b]Ladies and gentlemen, THIS day has arrived: Clash II version 1.0 is now available![/b] After over a year of tweaks, fixes and hard work, we are leaving the Early Access stage.

At the very beginning, we would like to once again thank everyone who took the time to check out the early versions of the game and share their ideas and thoughts with us. It is thanks to you that Clash II became the game we see here, and without you it would have been impossible. [b]But remember, this is not the end of the journey![/b] Reaching stage 1.0 is a milestone for us, laying the foundation for further development of the game. As today's update puts a new game mode - [b]hot seat[/b] - into your hands, this is what will be the main theme of future updates. We want to take the time to [b]create more maps[/b] for this game mode for you and add them in the form of regular patches. The game will also get [b]new language versions[/b], and perhaps some unannounced visual update! Of course, bugfixes and balance tweaks won't be left behind either - we keep referring to your feedback you leave on Discord.

[b]To celebrate this day, Clash II is available at a 15% discount until the end of February. So if the Early Access stage didn't convince you to give it a try, now might be a good time to set foot on the continent of Karkhan and support one of the sides in the conflict![/b]

Below you can watch the latest gameplay trailer made especially for today:

[previewyoutube=6mL2hfvuWFw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Purians Campaign! Update 07-02-2024
notes.content:
[b]Welcome![/b] After a nearly three-month long break, we bring you a huge update that not only improves almost every aspect of the game, but also adds the long-awaited campaign of the Purians faction! We hope the new adventure will keep you entertained for hours as you traverse Karkhan alongside Harwig, the commander of the Purians. 

[b]IMPORTANT: Due to huge changes in the game, the old save files will not work properly. However, the existing campaign progress will be preserved[/b].

What else awaits you in this update?

notes.title: First roadmap update!
notes.content:
After a long period of dedicated and enthusiastic work, we are thrilled to unveil major updates in Clash II. With appreciation for your invaluable feedback, we have crafted a host of new features for you to explore. We are very curious to hear your impressions!

Update July 6th:
[list]
[*]  Modernized version of almost the entire UI
[*]  Visual modifications to achieve a more climatic game world
[*]  Improved camera changes for better player visibility
[*]  Game balance improvements and fixes
[*]  New neutral units - bandits
[/list]

With this, we were able to tick off two points from our roadmap - a big step towards the end of the early access stage.

notes.title: Upcoming Update!
notes.content:
The upcoming update will change the user interface on the world map, battle maps and in the castle view. The interface has been reworked completely from scratch. Your feedback about the previous version was invaluable for our team, as we aimed to make the new one as intuitive and convenient to use as possible. The new interface was designed in parallel with the game mechanics and improvements that will be coming in the following updates. 

This is just the first of many great changes approaching the continent of Karkhan!

Be ready!
